<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2101-2024-10-02-16-30" status="finalized"> 'di'i sa mtshams bshad pa na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7348">kun lan <choice><reg>da</reg><orig>‹da›</orig></choice></rs> zhes pa na re sa brgyad pa la yin no zhes pa dang | 
                <rs type="person" ref="db:3827" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'brom</rs> na re sa dgu pa nas yin te sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi sar gsungs pa'i <lb n="27a6"/> phyir ro zhes zer ro ||
         de dag ni mi 'thad pa de gal te de lta yin la de dag gi skad cig gnyis pa la bcu cig kun tu 'od sangs rgyas kyi sar thal ba'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
